Counsel with
a conscience

Since 2016, Nyama Law Chambers has stood for justice — not just in the courtroom, but in the lives of every Zimbabwean we serve.

2016Est. Harare
Who We Are

Built on purpose,
driven by justice

Nyama Law Chambers was founded in 2016 at 4 Bates Street, Milton Park, Harare — a full-service firm of attorneys, conveyancers, notaries, commercial lawyers, labour consultants, trademark and patent agents, commissioners of oaths, and child rights consultants.

We believe the law should work for everyone. That belief shapes how we approach each matter: not merely as a legal transaction, but as an opportunity to genuinely change a client’s circumstances for the better.

We bridge the gap in Zimbabwe’s justice system for children, women, the elderly, widows, widowers and persons with disabilities.
We bring specialist depth across nine practice areas — from the family home to the boardroom and the courtroom.
We are licensed, experienced practitioners committed to ethical, transparent and effective legal representation.
Get In Touch
Our Mission

Why we do this

"We advocate for social justice in the justice delivery system. Vulnerable groups such as children, women, our elderly, widows, widowers and persons living with disabilities deserve the equal protection of the law — and we are committed to bridging this gap."

This is not a tagline. It is the founding principle of Nyama Law Chambers — and the reason we show up, every day, for every client.
